sfx_naming: All 13 sfx/*.wav names exactly match the Whimsical Forest audio pack.

usage.danger_layered: Play tides_danger_layer_30s.wav synchronized with the normal loop from the same playhead; fade layer gain in/out. Alternatively use tides_danger_full_loop_30s.wav at the same playhead. Do not combine danger layer and danger full.
usage.victory: Fade or stop music, then play tides_victory_stinger.wav once.
usage.sfx: Use the same event-to-filename mapping as Whimsical Forest.

note: Original programmatically synthesized retro chiptune. Seam endpoints briefly faded to avoid clicks.
